integrity: Full proof in RESULT.md; reproducible standard-library brute-force and exact coefficient comparison in verify.py; no external or independent scientific validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to finite simple forests and counts named-palette colorings, not equivalence classes modulo color permutations. Exhaustive small-tree verification is finite and is not a proof for all orders. Literature searches cannot exclude all unindexed prior work.
title: Degree-factorization of the strong-odd coloring polynomial of forests
